layout.description: The layout the operations edit, by its key from themes.get; the master when omitted. createLayout and deleteLayouts take no layout.

operations.description: Applied in order to one file as one Undo step.

themeRevision.description: `themeRevision` from a fresh `themes.get` or `themes.edit`; a theme edited since refuses the change.

AgentAnimationMoment.description: The moment in a slide's motion an edit lands at, as the Animate tab's playhead sets it for the Inspector and the keyframe buttons: Start (`stepId` null), or `time` in a step.

rotation.description: Authored degrees. Animation keyframes allow explicit turns.

AgentObjectTransformSource.description: A transform as the file names an audio icon's place and a line's ends.

AgentSpaceTransform.description: A 3D object's move: any parts of its position, its whole rotation in its rotation mode and any parts of a model's or a light's scale. The parts it leaves out stay as they are.

AgentThemeObjectOperation.description: An edit of the theme document's objects, as on a slide: the master or the layout is edited as one slide, whose `slideId` any value names. A picture names a file of the presentation, which the theme takes a copy of.

files.description: The embedded files carrying the family's faces, in the theme; omitted for a family MarkdownPoint includes.

source.description: `computer` embeds the family installed on this computer: the app copies its faces and names their files.

anyOf.description: The master's settings the file names otherwise than the panes: a grid and guides as the file writes them, and the step duration.

AgentThemeOperation.description: A master or layout edit, as the canvas, the Master pane and the Layout pane make it, plus making and deleting layouts. A theme's name is its master's, so the master's own `setName` is not among them.

AgentTransformFrame.description: The frame a transform gives an object, where it is drawn: every side, but a table's height only where the edit sizes the table. A text box that grows to its words may leave its height out, as a height sizes nothing there; a width its words give it sizes nothing either.

at.description: Last checkpoint or deletion position; a live target takes precedence.

MasterGridSource.description: A grid as the file writes it: its columns, with a gutter and margin of 0 when left out, and its baseline from its start at its increment.

MasterGuideSource.description: A guide as the file writes it: at `x` an upright line, at `y` a level one.

ObjectPropertyChangeSource.description: One property and its value; null restores its default, or with clear: true clears what an inherited object inherits. Every number keeps the millionth.

target.description: the id of an object on the slide

target-joint.description: the name of one of the model’s joints

value.description: SVG path data in frame units

ObjectPropertySourceKey.description: A property's key in the file.

PathThroughPoint.description: A point a curve passes through; a corner keeps a sharp angle there instead of a smooth turn.

PresentationDrawnTextFrame.description: A text box's frame where it is drawn, as an insert or a paste gives it. One that grows to its words (auto-size height or both, on no path) is as tall as they are: a height given sizes nothing. One whose words give it its width (auto-size width or both, on no path, in one column) is as wide as they are: the width given sizes nothing, and the box grows from the point its alignment holds on the frame given.

PresentationInsertObjectSource.description: An object to insert, in the file's words. A path is drawn either through `d` or through `points`.

PresentationPasteObjectSource.description: A pasted object, in the file's words.

PresentationPastedAttachedLineEnd.description: A pasted line end on an object of the same paste, by index as `parentIndex`; `at` is where it stands until attached.

PresentationReplicaArrangement.description: A replica's copies in a grid a gap apart, or a ring a radius from the selection's center, as groups and repeaters.

PresentationRotation3d.description: How a 3D object turns, in degrees about the 3D space's axes (x right, y up, z toward the viewer), in Cinema 4D's HPB order: heading about y, then pitch about its own x, then bank about its own z, three.js's YXZ Euler. A positive z turns it counterclockwise on the slide, a positive x tilts its top toward the viewer and a positive y brings its left side forward. With the rotation mode "quaternion" it is a quaternion instead, `w` and `x`, `y`, `z` in the same axes, which a key interpolates part by part and the turn reads normalized. A model's Blender quaternion (w, x, y, z), exported to glTF with +Y up, is (w, x, z, −y) here.

PresentationTableFrame.description: A table's frame as the files hold it: its height is its rows', and never stored.

PresentationTransformFrame.description: The frame a transform gives an object: every side, but a table's height only where the edit sizes the table, as a move leaves its rows as they are.

ThemeArtworkMutation.description: A theme picture's file: without `scheme` one file every scheme shows; with it, that scheme's alone.

Prop_text.scale.description: A single object's scale along its own x and y axes.

Prop_wipe.description: A linear wipe, as After Effects': a feathered edge travels at its angle; progress 0 hides, 1 shows all.

anyOf.description: a color role or a hex color

color.description: a color role or a hex color
a color role or a hex color

Prop_text-direction.description: The side a text box's lines start on: the left, or the right for words written right to left, as Arabic and Hebrew are.

Prop_auto-size.description: How a text frame follows its words: it grows to them on both sides, on one, or keeps the size it was given.

Prop_text-path.description: SVG path data in frame units

color.description: a color role or a hex color without opacity, such as "#000000"

Prop_text.drop-shadow.description: An object's shadow: a drop shadow, or none. An object without the property casts none; "none" is written only to take back a shadow it would otherwise inherit from its layout or its presentation.

Prop_text-stroke.description: a color role or a hex color

Prop_anchor-point.description: Where an object's animated turn and scale pivot, as fractions across and down its frame: 0 to 1 within it, and past it beside it.

Prop_model.description: A text's 3D model as the file spells it.

additionalProperties.description: one line with one space between words, none at the start or end, and no "-->"

Prop_bind.description: Property name to control name; `text` and `file` name the object's content.

Prop_enter.description: A text's entrance, its pose, spread and progress left out where they are the defaults, as the file writes it.

Prop_exit.description: A text's exit, written as its entrance is.

anyOf.description: a color role or a hex color

color.description: a color role or a hex color
a color role or a hex color

Prop_fill.description: A fill as the file spells it: `none`, one color, or a gradient whose stops name their colors.

color.description: a color role or a hex color without opacity, such as "#000000"

Prop_image.drop-shadow.description: An object's shadow: a drop shadow, or none. An object without the property casts none; "none" is written only to take back a shadow it would otherwise inherit from its layout or its presentation.

Prop_image-style.description: nonempty text without NUL characters, or "none"

Prop_media-trim.description: The span of its file a movie or sound plays, in seconds. Its end, when given, is after its start. A loop repeats it.

Prop_shape.flip.description: An object mirrored in its frame: across its vertical axis, its horizontal one, or both.

propertyNames.description: one line with one space between words, none at the start or end, and no "-->"

Prop_chart-type.description: What a chart draws from its table: columns standing up from or bars lying along its categories, side by side or stacked, a line or a stacked area per series, a pie or a donut of its first series, or a counter that counts to its first value in that cell's spelling.

anyOf.description: a color role or a hex color

Prop_auto-layout.description: An auto layout as the file spells it, its reference point `reference-point`, left out at start.

Prop_model.position.description: A point in the 3D space, in canvas units: x right from the slide's left edge, y up from its bottom edge, z toward the viewer.

Prop_rotation-mode.description: The rotation mode, of the two of Blender's the format takes: absent, Euler degrees; `quaternion`, a quaternion (WXYZ).

Prop_model.scale.description: A 3D object's scale along its own x, y and z axes.

owner-joint.description: the name of one of the model’s joints

target.description: the id of an object on the slide

strength.description: A fraction: 0 does nothing, 1 all the constraint does.

volume.description: A multiple of the model's own volume at the scale it holds: 1, the default, keeps it as it is, and 0.4 squeezes it to 40% of that. Not the model's size, which is its scale.

strength.description: A fraction: 0 does nothing, 1 all the constraint does.

Prop_constraints.description: The model's constraints, in the order they run; each id is unique on the model.

Prop_light.shape.description: An area light's shape, as Redshift's Area Shape names its two: a rectangle, or a disk, round or oval.

Prop_orientation.description: The axis a shadow catcher's face looks along at no turn: y lying flat, z standing as a wall.

Prop_floor.position.description: Where a floor stands: its height above the slide's bottom edge, in canvas units.

Prop_rotation.description: Authored degrees. Animation keyframes allow explicit turns.
